name: VM Chat Member
description: One participant of a VM Chat Room. `last_read_seq` is the per-user read cursor the unread badge is computed from.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Admins can add/remove members and rename the room.

fields.label: Last Read Seq
fields.description: Highest message seq this user has read. Unread = room.last_seq - this.

fields.label: Last Delivered Seq
fields.description: Highest seq this member's device has actually pulled. Drives the second tick.

fields.label: Push
fields.description: Send FCM for messages in this room. Independent of `muted`, which only silences the in-app badge.
